column5: Tomorrowland no es solo un festival, se siente como entrar en un mundo completamente diferente. Desde el momento en que entras, todo es mágico, vibrante y lleno de vida. Los diseños escénicos son irreales, con luces, imágenes y temas que se sienten como algo salido de un sueño.
column8: Very satisfied with the experience.

column5: Creo IT es importante para los organizadores escuchar esto: la experiencia se sintió diluida y por el precio que pagamos, merecíamos más transparencia sobre cambios como este. No estoy diciendo IT no fuera divertido, bailé, lo intenté, pero la magia simplemente no estaba ahí como antes. IT también es muy caro.
column8: Complains about the organization and the general experience.

column5: Fue un festival increíble. Creo que es repugnante cómo Tomorrowland está más preocupado por las ganancias que por la seguridad de la gente. No hay estaciones de recarga de agua ni agua potable en ningún lugar del terreno. Carteles diciendo que no beban el agua de los baños que todos estaban.
column8: Disappointment with the security and problems to get free water.

column5: En general el teatro y la música era increíble. Mis quejas son en torno al servicio al cliente y procesos generales. En primer lugar, si vienes de Amberes en tren es un paseo de 30 minutos o más todos los días. 2 veces al día para llegar a la entrada del festival y volver. Si la organización ofreciera un servicio de transporte, estoy seguro de que la gente pagaría por usarlo.
column8: The customer praises the music but reports dissatisfaction with transportation and customer service.

column5: ¡Es una experiencia que todos deberían tener en su vida! ¡La forma en que se organiza el festival es increíble teniendo en cuenta la cantidad de asistentes! ¡Es básicamente Disneyland para los amantes del EDM! Incluso si usted no está en EDM uno puede ir por la vibra del lugar y el increíble valor de producción que ofrece!
column8: Very positive comments of the festival and organization.

column5: Es complicado resumir la experiencia en un comentario tan pequeño. Soy un loco de la música electrónica que lleva más de 10 años viendo el streaming de Tomorrowland y soñando como un niño con ir algún día. Finalmente lo conseguimos. La experiencia cumple sobradamente con las expectativas. Es indescriptible el grado de detalle y la cantidad de staff que hay para cualquier tontería.
column8: Expresses satisfaction with the whole festival staff and experience.

column5: Después de haber visto videos y escuchado One World Radio por accidente, Tomorrowland estaba en la lista de deseos de mi esposo. ¿Eramos demasiado viejos a los 69 y 64 años respectivamente? De hecho les aseguraba a los de 30 años que no eran demasiado viejos. ¿Valió la pena ir? Por supuesto. Si te gusta la música electrónica de baile y el ambiente que lo acompaña, este es el festival para ti.
column8: The customer expresses total satisfaction even with an advanced age for the festival and the venues.

column5: Que experiencia. Mi esposa y yo habíamos estado tratando de llegar aquí durante años y finalmente llegamos aquí después de obtener nuestros boletos en enero de 2020 solo para que covid entrara y suspendiera los festivales, pero después de esperar tanto, fue genial finalmente bailar sin parar para 3 días.
column8: Very positive experience at the festival.

column5: Pedí una camisa en la tienda de Tomorrow Land. Aunque seleccioné un plazo de envío "al día siguiente" y pagué más por ello, la entrega requirió el hotel una semana después de que salí del país. Acercarse a su servicio de atención al cliente fue inútil. El representante me refirió a las letras pequeñas diciendo que la empresa no asume ninguna responsabilidad por entregas tardías.
column8: Negative comments about the delayed delivery and the poor  customer experience.

column5: ¡Esta fue de nuevo una gran experiencia para nosotros! Diferentes tipos de música con gente de todo el mundo. Gran ambiente y buena comida 👍
column8: Very good comments about the music, the people and the food.

column5: Whaouuuuuuuu 😍 súper música aún más súper - entorno y la comida en el restaurante TML era mente - impresionante! Preparado por Michelin star - chefs 😍
column8: Very satisfied with the music, the ambient and the amazing food.

column5: Fuimos en una gira grupal al festival de la compañía Festway. Mi esposo soñaba con ir por 5 años, pero no podía comprar boletos todo el tiempo. Las impresiones son súper, una cosa es cuando lo ves todo en la foto, pero en la vida real el paisaje es simplemente mágico.
column8: The customers had very positive comments about the festival and the group experience.

column5: Es la experiencia más única, genuina, mágica y diferente que puedas vivir. Toda la experiencia desde el principio está muy bien montada. El entorno es una auténtica locura y los djs son los mejores del mundo. HAY QUE IR AL MENOS UNA VEZ EN LA VIDA
column8: Very positive comments about the experience, the music, the djs and the organization.

column5: Estaba entusiasmado pero la experiencia fue normal. Bebidas de mierda, decoración de mierda. Hacía mucho frío y llovía y no nos permitieron volver al campamento para conseguir o cambiarnos de ropa.
column8: The customer complains and feels very frustrated because of the drinks, the rain and the bad organization.

column5: Es complicado resumir la experiencia en un comentario tan pequeño. Soy un loco de la música electrónica que lleva más de 10 años viendo el streaming de Tomorrowland y soñando como un niño con ir algún día.
column8: Very positive comments about the whole experience.

column5: El 22 de julio mi brazalete se debe haber roto mientras estaba en el festival donde alguien debió encontrar el chip en el medio y usó más de la mitad de todas mis perlas del fin de semana completo.
column8: The customer reports a negative experience after losing the bracelet chip and having the balance used by someone else.

column5: ¡El mejor momento de todos! Muchas personas viajan aquí desde Aus, Brasil, etc. Realmente vale la pena experimentarlo al menos una vez.
column8: Very positive comments about the experience in the festival.

column5: Servicio de mierda. No puedo ir porque tengo una competencia importante que no conocía de antemano. Pregunté si podía venderlo a otra persona, pero no es posible. Pidió un reembolso. Imposible. Ni siquiera respondió a mi último correo electrónico.
column8: The customer complains about the awful service and the impossibility of changing or selling the ticket for another person.

column5: ¡Tomorrowland 2022 fue la mejor experiencia de mi vida! ! ! ¡Qué evento tan organizado! ¡Decoración mágica! Amplios espacios! ¡Grandes escenarios, el sonido fue increíble, la alineación, la gente muy amable! ¡La comida! ¡El personal! ¡Todo fue tan lindo y tan mágico! ¡Solo ve, no te arrepentirás! ¡Quiero ir de nuevo!
column8: Very good comments about the music, the people, the organization and the venues.

column5: ¡El tercer año en Tomorrowland sigue mejorando! ¡Realmente es el mejor lugar que jamás visitarás! Sí, es caro, pero obtienes lo que pagas, mejor multitud, servicio y calidad.
column8: The customer likes the festival and considers the experience worth the price.

column5: I was skeptical about having so many teams, but I have to admit that the clear underdogs performed quite well. On the other hand, I don't know - maybe it's just me - but it seems like the broadcast is being handled by people with no experience in football specifically. Technically, everything is fine, but the choice of camera angles, replays, and so on is kind of strange.
column8: The customer appreciates the performance of the underdog teams but criticizes the broadcast production and camera choices.

column5: I think it’s been fantastic and I’m not really a soccer/futbol fan. Love seeing the other teams fans going out there and having fun too.
column8: Good comments about the tournament and the fans coming from another countries.

column5: Very disappointed with the new showing offside late rule and the „hydration breaks“. Otherwise it’s fine for now
column8: Customer expresses disappointment with the new rules and hydration breaks but otherwise the tournament is fine.

column5: It's so much fun. I think it's one of the greatest World Cups ever.
column8: Very good comments about the tournament.

column5: I'm just sitting back and enjoying it. No pressure, just picking every game a team to root for. Not a fan of the cooling breaks clearly done to appease the Advertising Overlords. And the time zone isn't great. But overall is just "enjoyable".
column8: The customer likes the games and enjoys them but think that the cooling breaks are just for advertising.

column5: I live in a host city and the vibe has been mostly positive. The traffic and logistical nightmare hasn't really materialized. Matches have been well attended and good for the most part. Happy tourists in the city and the abundance of activities and watch parties have added to the vibe.
column8: Very positive comments about the organization,

column5: Regarding the game, unnecessary breaks are a disgrace. Regarding the WC as a whole, I would like to see more of Canada and Mexico in the media. It feels like the yankees are alone in this. Regarding Fifa... I will keep this comment clean.
column8: Bad comments about the cooling breaks and the limited participation of Mexico and Canada.

column5: Overall I am enjoying it, but that is less so the location and the hosts and moreso that it is a world cup. The biggest sporting event in the world.
column8: Good comments about the event but the customer does not demonstrate much excitement about it.

column5: Fortunately much of it is going on in the middle of the night here in europe.. So less matches seen.. lesser to complain about... Think it is strange to see a world cup with haiti, congo, qatar etc. while no Italy.
column8: Complains of the match times and the teams that participate on the tournament.

column5: I'm loving it. It's the World Cup. People always say it's going to be a let down and then it's always awesome.
column8: Very positive comments of the tournament.

column5: not sure the global opinion on it but most western folks are having a danny devito i get it moment to football as a whole this world cup. this is the first world cup for alot of people in the west so its really special and will be remebered for alot of folks here.
column8: Positive comments for the people who can watch a world cup for the first time in the West location.

column5: The rich countries had the stands packed with the poorest nations with little support. Egypt played well and the refs demonstrated a pure bias against them. I love Messi but Argentina has been meh and I predict they win this cup but are not totally deserving.
column8: The customer complains about the financial inequality, the referees and the Argentine team.

column5: As for the tournament itself - there had been some good games, but honestly I hate the times they are played at.Game against Panama was on a workday at 1am, and they say if we go through as the 3rd placed team that our round of 32 game might be at 3am.
column8: The customer complains of the match times of the games where he lives.

column5: So far so good I guess, but I notice a lot more goals this year than in previous tournaments and some of them are long-shot goals. Maybe this year's football is similar to 2010 football?
column8: Positive comments of the tournament and the quantity of goals.

column5: The US has been massively depressed since covid and everything has been focused on the most depressing news shoved in our face nonstop. But the World Cup has basically taken over and gave us a cleanse that was desperately needed. The gloom and doom has subsided overall and it's the best our country has felt in a long time.
column8: The customer describes the difficult situation in the country, but the World Cup bring positive vibes.

column5: Possibly the worst world cup so far, too big, a list of nothing ties in the group stages, we might see a decent pairing at some time in the third round, the hydration breaks are just a means of Americanising the sport; IE, adding more commercial breaks, stadiums are empty, tickets so steep no one on a working class salary can afford to go to the games.
column8: Very negative comments about the draws, tickets prices and the cooling breaks used for advertising.

column5: Everything American about it sucks, but the actual football has been great even though I stay with the assessment that this group stage feels more like a play in stage to the World Cup.
column8: Negative comments of the country but positive comments of the group stage and the games.

column5: I hate the times the games start more than the hydration breaks, which I also hate. But it'd rather take a LONGER hydration break if it meant the games started some normal time.
column8: Negative comments of the match times and the hydration breaks.

column5: To not be completely negative, I do appreciate that the VAR referee now actively looks for and penalises players for diving and acting. Also, the stadiums are large and seem to have a good atmosphere. It's nice to actually see it raining at some of these matches instead of all the stadiums being indoors or having roofs.
column8: Good comments about use of  the VAR and some open air stadiums.

column5: Also the referees are not leaning on VAR anywhere near as much as the prem has been and this I feel, is how it should be implemented. If it isn't a clear and obvious error, the referees decision goes.
column8: The customer approves of the limited use of VAR and believes it is being implemented correctly.

column5: EA FC 25 offers a much more polished gameplay and adds enough details to make the experience at the controls much better. In addition, the new career mode is now more interesting and deeper for those of us who enjoy creating our own legacy.
column8: The customer appreciates the changes on gameplay details and the new career mode.

column5: It`s hard to describe a game that has turned into a pure content conveyor over the years. If you were expecting any major changes in EA Sports FC 25, I have to disappoint you, there really aren`t any.
column8: The customer criticizes the lack of meaningful changes in the new version.

column5: Its incredible, that a studio with such manpower, experience, resources and knowlegde can produce this garbage. Why? I don't understand.
column8: Very negative comments of the company who made the game.

column5: Very fun game but has a few glitches in the game play. For example when the game starts, sometimes there won't be a whistle to remind me. The same applies to free kicks and more I'm too lazy to name them all.
column8: The customer likes the game but notes some technical issues, such as missing whistle  sounds during the free kicks.

column5: The only multiplayer game I've played where I have lag spikes and unstable connection every single game. It is unplayable and I should get a refund for this absolute dumpster fire. I genuinely would rather use the money that I spent on this as toilet paper.
column8: Very negative comments about the unstable network connection and request for a refund.

column5: Bugs, scripted goals, no creativity and by game decided passes and goals. Especially if you are playing season, the game decides you to stay in the same division.
column8: The customer strongly criticizes the lack of creativity, the bugs and the decision of the game to stay in the same division.

column5: Yo, FC 25 is straight fire, man. The graphics? Insane. Like, you look around and it’s a freakin’ masterpiece. Characters, environments, all that detail—chef’s kiss, bro. Story? Deep as heck, keeps you hooked. Combat?
column8: Very positive comments of the game, the graphics and the high quality details.

column5: There's no point in having licenses for the best leagues and clubs in the world if you don't have decent gameplay. This is one of the worst FIFA games in history. The players don't respond to commands and are dumb to the point of losing patience.
column8: Strongly disappointment for the gameplay, unresponsive commands and the overall experience.

column5: It's terrible in every respect except for the image quality, so please don't buy it. It's too expensive even on sale, and I don't want to pay for it to play. The AI is especially stupid.
column8: The customer criticizes the high price and the weak AI performance.

column5: Huge fifa fan. Not calling it by the new name. Sadly no longer a football simulation. Now its a betting site.
column8: The customer complains about the new version of the game and remark that it is becoming a betting site.
